meta.name: Los Farad
meta.description: The day Oskar, a typical local boy, crosses paths with the mysterious and wealthy Farad family, his life changes forever. Oskar enters a winner-take-all game, the world of international arms trafficking. In Marbella where the Farads live, luxury, adrenaline and intense emotions await him... But also a backside of violence and cynicism that tests his will.

videos.title: Import and Export
videos.overview: Oskar looks for his place in Madrid in the 1980's. Orphaned and hardened by the difficult environment in which he grew up, at 27 only one thing is clear to him: he has to get ahead no matter what. So the day he crosses paths with the mysterious and rich Sara Farad, he leaps at his chance to peer into the luxurious and exciting life that could await him with her and her family...

videos.title: From Aluche to Marbella
videos.overview: Oskar moves in with the Farad family in Marbella. In less than a week he's gone from barely paying the rent for his apartment in Aluche to living with Sara in the family's luxurious mansion, from riding across the city on his motorcycle to sailing on a yacht across the Costa del Sol. But not everything will be so easy: to be a Farad, you have to prove yourself.

videos.title: Lions and In-Laws
videos.overview: With the opening of his brand new gym in Marbella, Oskar seems to have achieved all his dreams in record time. But Leo Farad has seen in him more than just a good son-in-law, and decides to take him on a peculiar hunt to close an important business deal. Meanwhile, one of Leo's daughters makes a discovery that will force the Farad siblings to review their position in the family.

videos.title: Perestroika
videos.overview: After marrying Sara, Oskar can say it now: he is officially a Farad. And that means many things: loyalty, total trust... And also dealing with little family issues. Trying to help Leo get his son Hugo back on track, Oskar goes with his problematic brother-in-law on a high-seas operation: they have to take an important secret weapons shipment to safe harbor.

videos.title: Terrorist Manual
videos.overview: Leo Farad is capable of negotiating anything except one thing: the safety of his family. When his daughter Tanya is assaulted by strangers, Leo's fury turns to his closest rival: Mawad. With a war between families about to break out, news arrives that adds to the tension: Khalid, a Palestinian associate of the Farads, has stormed a hotel in Monaco, taking dozens of hostages.

videos.title: Look the Other Way
videos.overview: Leo wants Mawad's head, and he'll do anything to get it... even make a deal with the Americans. While Oskar and Sara welcome the birth of their first son, the rest of the family takes a plane to Czechoslovakia with the excuse of enrolling Tanya in a singing school. But Leo's true intentions are actually quite different...

videos.title: A New Species of Farad
videos.overview: The war has reached its climax in Angola. Oskar and Sara accompany Leo to the front lines to close a cannon sale. For the first time, Oskar has first-hand knowledge of what the arms business is all about. Meanwhile, in Marbella, Hugo is determined to show his family what he is capable of by putting an end to the conflict with Mawad once and for all.

videos.title: The Final Decision
videos.overview: Carmen decides that the time has come to make a deal with Mawad: she's unwilling to take any more losses in her family. But the deal can only be closed if blood is shed one more time. Oskar's defining moment has arrived and he'll have to face what it truly means to be a "Farad" with all its consequences.
